verdict.rationale: Canny's own JavaScript SDK identifies users so that the feedback they leave is tied to their existing customer account. The product itself links each feedback item to the customer who submitted it. Company-level association is also documented (Install Companies), and MCP docs mention seeing the context and ARR behind each customer request. missing for 10: PM-side manual linking of feedback to a customer (e.g. logging feedback on a customer's behalf), detailed first-party docs on per-item customer attribution, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can link individual feedback items to the specific customers who submitted them

citations.quote: Install our JavaScript SDK to identify your users. This way, when they leave feedback on Canny, it'll be tied to their existing user account in your application.
Ask your LLM what customers asked for and understand the context behind each request.
